newsitem.title: USA: Edward Miller recommended as Equitable's CEO.
newsitem.headline: Edward Miller recommended as Equitable's CEO.

text.p: Equitable Cos Inc said Wednesday its chief executive Joseph Melone picked Edward Miller, formerly of Chase Manhattan Corp, to succeed him as president and chief executive of the company and its subsidiary Equitable Life Assurance Society of the U.S.
Melone, 65, will recommend Miller's appointment to Equitable's board of directors at its meeting July 17, the company said.

A spokesman said Melone was not retiring but will continue as chairman of Equitable Life. He added Melone will become chairman of the Equitable Cos' executive committee, replacing Claude Bear, who will remain chairman of Axa-UAP, a major shareholder in Equitable.
